notes.title: Don’t Let Me Fade is now live on Steam - and it’s free to play!
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45682026/507e63a58e3552f0f61e8491dd4bf885057fe554.jpg"][/img]Don’t Let Me Fade is now live on Steam - and it’s free to play! 🎮

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3837970/Dont_Let_Me_Fade/"][/dynamiclink]Created in just 48 hours during a GG-jam 2025, this tiny narrative game quickly made an impact on itch_io - and now it's reaching a broader audience✨
It’s short. It’s quiet. But it lingers.
And yes - there’s the only one Steam achievement waiting at the end.
If you enjoy the mood, you can support me by getting the original soundtrack, featuring two tracks made during the jam and a special bonus piece from Mirrorandum.
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3838320/Dont_Let_Me_Fade_Soundtrack/"][/dynamiclink]
Take a moment - and don’t let this fade![/p]
